title: Battle of the Birds: Eagles vs. Hawks vs. Owls

questions.sentence: If I _____ a bird of prey, I would have super vision.
questions.explain: Second conditional: if + past simple (were), would + base verb.

questions.question: Which sentence is a second conditional?
options: If I were a falcon, I would dive at 200 miles an hour.
If I am a falcon, I will dive at 200 miles an hour.
If I was a falcon, I dive at 200 miles an hour.
If I were a falcon, I dive at 200 miles an hour.
questions.explain: If + past simple, would + base verb.

questions.sentence: If you _____ able to fly so quietly, no one would hear you coming.

questions.question: Which is the correct second conditional form?
options: If you were able to fly quietly, no one would hear you.
If you are able to fly quietly, no one would hear you.
If you were able to fly quietly, no one will hear you.
If you were able to fly quietly, no one hears you.
questions.explain: If + past simple, would + base verb.

questions.sentence: If an eagle _____ (not have) sharp talons, it couldn't catch food.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: If an eagle didn't have sharp talons, it couldn't catch food.
If an eagle doesn't have sharp talons, it couldn't catch food.
If an eagle didn't had sharp talons, it couldn't catch food.
If an eagle wouldn't have sharp talons, it couldn't catch food.

questions.sentence: If I _____ (visit) Antarctica, I wouldn't see a peregrine falcon.
questions.explain: If + past simple (visited), wouldn't + base verb.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: If I visited Antarctica, I wouldn't see a peregrine falcon.
If I visit Antarctica, I wouldn't see a peregrine falcon.
If I visited Antarctica, I won't see a peregrine falcon.
If I would visit Antarctica, I didn't see a peregrine falcon.
questions.explain: If + past simple, wouldn't + base verb.

questions.sentence: If an owl _____ (can) move its eyes, it wouldn't bob its head.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: If an owl could move its eyes, it wouldn't bob its head.
If an owl can move its eyes, it wouldn't bob its head.
If an owl could move its eyes, it won't bob its head.
If an owl would can move its eyes, it didn't bob its head.

questions.sentence: If the burrowing owl _____ (not live) underground, it wouldn't be so safe.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: If the owl didn't live underground, it wouldn't be so safe.
If the owl doesn't live underground, it wouldn't be so safe.
If the owl didn't lived underground, it wouldn't be so safe.
If the owl wouldn't live underground, it didn't be so safe.
questions.explain: If + past simple (didn't live), wouldn't + base verb.

questions.correct: If I were a burrowing owl, I would live underground.
questions.explain: If + past simple, would + base verb.

questions.question: Which sentence uses 'would rather' correctly?
options: I'd rather be the burrowing owl.
I rather be the burrowing owl.
I'd rather to be the burrowing owl.
I'd rather being the burrowing owl.
